CustomField.label: If Query Field Value Is Empty
CustomField.description: How to handle empty field values while comparing query results. Applies to Check records with a query and Compare two queries checks. Ignored for Check fields on this record, Use custom Apex, and pure aggregate queries.

value.label: Treat empty values as not matching

CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ignore records with empty values (default) = leave them out of the comparison. Treat empty values as blank = compare an empty value as blank text. Treat empty values as not matching = an empty value always fails the comparison.
